bank.about: Ione keeps the city's coin safe. Nothing here costs a tide.
do: Purse: the coin you spend. Shops only take Purse coin, and thieves can take it too.
Vault: savings. They earn a little every season and can't be stolen.
Leviathan Credit: borrow up to your limit. Pay at least the minimum each season, or pay a fee and lose Standing.
Standing: how far the Bank trusts you. It rises when you pay on time and keep your card balance low.

market.about: Where the city buys its food and its treasure.
do: Your household eats 20 kelp every season. Kelp is cheapest in Summer and dearest in the Long Dark.
Your cellar holds up to 60 kelp. Stored kelp spoils a little each season.
Pearls keep their value as prices rise, but sell for less in the Long Dark panic.
Every unit you buy nudges the price up, and every unit you sell nudges it down.
market.cost: Your first trip each season is free. Later trips cost a tide.

harbor.about: Buy shares in the shipping houses, and buy Passage on the last ship.
do: Every house sends out a voyage each season. Success raises its share price; failure drops it.
Oro & Daughters is steady and pays a small dividend. Leviathan Line swings big. Deepcoral rarely wins.
The Tide Index holds a little of every house, so one bad voyage hurts less.
No ships sail in the Long Dark, and every share falls 20% when it begins. Sell before then if you need the coin.
Passage is paid from your Purse, and only if you owe nothing to anyone.
harbor.cost: Your first visit each season is free. Later visits cost a tide.

guild_hall.about: Where the city works. Sefa hands out the shifts.
do: A shift pays your wage and spends one tide.
Every season has six tides. When they run out, the season ends.
Resting lets a tide pass. Ending the season skips whatever tides are left.

drowned_bell.about: Nerissa's tavern: the best rumors in Atlantis, and a game or two.
do: Spending time here makes tavern rumors likelier. They're right about seven times in ten.
Nerissa deals three games a season. The odds are chalked on the board.
Every game pays back a little less than it takes. That's how a tavern stays open.

black_reef.about: Grin lends to anyone, no questions asked.
do: Borrow up to 300◈, even with no Standing at all.
Grin's fee is half again every season: 100◈ becomes 150◈, then 225◈.
Nobody boards the last ship owing Grin.
black_reef.cost: Free to visit. Expensive to leave.

circle.about: Old Maro's lending circle: neighbours who pool their coin and take turns.
do: Every season each member puts in, and one member takes the whole pot.
Taking the pot early is a loan from your neighbours. You pay it back a little each season.
Keep every payment and the circle stands by you when it matters most.

council.about: The Council of Ten rules Atlantis. Herald Kaito speaks for it, and what he says is always true.
do: The Council sets the tithe (40◈ a season) and the Vault's interest rate.
It can also debase the coin: prices, shares and Passage jump, but the coin you hold stays the same.
Passage gets dearer every season.

maro_questions.q: What do you owe, and to whom? Nobody boards that ship owing.
Your card grows a little every season. What will it cost if you only ever pay the minimum?
If your roof leaked tomorrow, where would the coin come from?
Passage climbs every season. Is your coin climbing faster than the price?
That coin in your Purse: is it working for you, or just waiting to be stolen?
Kelp is dearest in the Long Dark. How full will your cellar be when the dark comes?
You have your Passage. Who else in this city could use a little help?
When the tide turns against you, who would you turn to?

shells.name: Nerissa's Shells
shells.rules: Three shells, one pearl. Pick the shell with the pearl and win back 2.5× your stake.

wheel.name: The Kraken's Wheel
wheel.rules: Spin the wheel. Most spins land on the kraken and take your stake; a few pay double, four times, or ten times.

win: Nerissa slides your winnings across the bar. "Don't spend it all in one tide."
The whole tavern cheers. Nerissa just smiles.
"Luck's on your side tonight," says Nerissa. "It usually changes its mind."
lose: Nerissa sweeps your coin into the till. "The board doesn't lie, love."
The kraken wins again. It usually does.
"Every game pays back less than it takes," Nerissa reminds you, not unkindly.
tavern.limit: Nerissa wipes down the table. "That's enough games for one season."
